project_type: Node.js/Express 5 REST backend (createApp factory, repo/service/controller layering, in-memory OR Postgres DB) + Vite 8 / React 19 / react-router 7 frontend. Full local stack via docker-compose (nginx :8080, Postgres pgvector :5432, Mailpit :1025/:8025, MinIO, DynamoDB-local).
build_system: npm per package. Backend has no build step (plain node). Frontend uses Vite (vite build). Quirk: backend package.json "type":"commonjs"; frontend "type":"module".
test_framework: Backend unit tests: node:test runner via `npm test` = node --test "test/*Service.test.js". Backend e2e: Jest (`npm run test:e2e` = jest --runInBand) gated on TEST_DATABASE_URL/DATABASE_URL and self-skips offline. Frontend has no test runner; verification is `npm run build` + `npm run lint` (oxlint).
test_command: backend unit: npm test (in <WT>\backend) ; backend e2e: npm run test:e2e ; frontend: npm run build && npm run lint
verification_instructions: 1) <WT>\backend: npm install then npm test (all test/*Service.test.js green). 2) <WT>\backend: npm run test:e2e exits 0 offline (suites self-skip) and passes against pgvector/pgvector:pg16 when TEST_DATABASE_URL is set. 3) <WT>\frontend: npm install then npm run build and npm run lint exit 0. Worktree git: git -C d:\Workspace\swd392_team7_product\.worktrees\e2e-step2-auth. Commit locally per FEAT; never push.
snapshot_or_generated_files: None checked in by build/test. The in-memory DB file backend/mock-database.json must stay untouched by tests (e2e helper hashes it to assert this).
environment_constraints: In-memory DB (src/db/createDatabase.js InMemoryDatabase) THROWS on any SQL it does not hard-code; new auth/admin SQL will NOT run through it. Unit-test services with injected FAKE repositories (createApp and every service accept injected repos), not through InMemoryDatabase. Real SQL runs only under the Postgres-gated Jest e2e. Migrations auto-run at startup only when DB_MOCK_MODE=false. Never edit an applied migration; next free number is 011. Local SMTP = Mailpit (SMTP_HOST=mailpit, port 1025, no auth, UI :8025).
contribution_requirements: No AGENTS.md/CONTRIBUTING found. Follow the existing createApp wiring pattern (repository -> service -> controller -> createXRouter(controller) -> app.use), the overrides.* injection convention for tests, and the *Service.test.js + node:test convention. Keep DB roles uppercase ADMIN/LECTURER/STUDENT. Keep frontend user-facing strings in the current language (English UI copy). Pin every new dependency to an exact version.
key_patterns: createApp(overrides) in src/app.js wires each resource and mounts routers; add cookie-parser + Origin(CSRF) middleware before routers. Errors use err.statusCode + err.code and the final error handler returns {message}. Services throw 400/401/403/404/409 errors. BackgroundJobRepository.enqueue(type,payload) feeds JobQueue (FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED worker, retry/backoff); handlers.js registers per-type handlers and must THROW on failure to trigger retry. app_user.password_hash currently nullable (set-password-by-link flow). Frontend fetch must use credentials:'include' for httpOnly cookies; fix api.js to import.meta.env.

decisions.jwt: Built-in Node crypto HMAC-SHA256, NO external JWT lib. Rationale: refresh tokens already stored hashed in auth_session, access tokens short-lived+stateless, project already mandates Node crypto (scrypt). Payload {sub,role,type,iat,exp,jti}; verify signature (timingSafeEqual) + exp.
decisions.password_hashing: crypto scrypt, 16-byte random salt, stored scrypt$N$r$p$<saltB64>$<hashB64>, min 8 chars, timingSafeEqual verify. NO bcrypt.
